overloads: func textSelectionActions(lookup: ((String) -> Void)? = nil, share: ((String) -> Void)? = nil) -> some View

name: TextSelectionScope
abstract: One selection shared by every paragraph of a document, so a drag can run from a heading through a list into a code block and copy as one string. Transient view state: owned by the mounted root, never persisted.

members.name: lookup
members.abstract: Optional hooks wired by the host so the selection toolbar can offer Look Up and Share. On Apple platforms the context menu already surfaces these natively; on Android they map to the action-mode bar's items. Both menu entries stay hidden until a hook is set, so a stock selection never offers a row that does nothing.

members.name: hasSelection
members.abstract: Whether anything is actually selected (an anchor with no focus is a caret, not a selection).

members.name: selectedText
members.abstract: Paragraphs on one row (table cells) join with tabs, rows with newlines.

name: TextShaper
abstract: Shapes text with HarfBuzz through a face owned by `CoveUIText`.
discussion:
The shaper holds no native handles of its own. It delegates to `FontFace`,
which is the only type in the tree that owns an `hb_font_t` — that is what
lets callers such as the desktop runtime work with text without binding
HarfBuzz themselves.

members.name: setFace
members.declaration: public func setFace(_ face: FontFace, size: Float)
members.abstract: Associates a face with this shaper.
discussion:
- Parameters:
  - face: A face loaded by `CoveUIText`.
  - size: Font size in logical points.

members.name: shape
members.declaration: public func shape( text: String, direction: TextDirection? = .ltr, script: ScriptTag? = Script.latin, language: String? = "en" ) -> [ShapedGlyph]
members.abstract: Shapes a string of text and returns positioned glyphs.
discussion:
- Parameters:
  - text: The input string.
  - direction: Writing direction (default LTR); `nil` lets HarfBuzz guess.
  - script: ISO 15924 tag (default Latin); `nil` lets HarfBuzz guess.
  - language: BCP 47 tag (default "en"); `nil` uses HarfBuzz's default.
- Returns: Array of shaped glyphs with positions.
